parameters.content:
## I.LPRC — LP report 135 "Lead Disposition Detail" (thin transport ONLY)

Gmail → select this report's attachment by **filename ID `_135_`** → POST raw PDF bytes → LP-MCP.
ZERO parsing here: every parse / validate / write rule lives in LP-MCP (fail-closed).
LP schedules this email ~6:30 ET daily · scope **MTD daily + YTD weekly** · feeds Leads by market, dispositions, source.

**Why one workflow per report (ruled 2026-08-05 §4).** A single combined router
was tried and rolled back: when all five reports arrive in the same poll window
it handled one and the rest were lost. Five independent triggers cannot drop a
sibling's report, and a change to one report never risks the other four.

**Routing is on the filename ID, not the subject.** Subject strings have already
caused misrouting; `_135_` is stable. The Code node examines EVERY message in
the poll and EVERY attachment in each message, so simultaneous arrivals all flow.

**Failure handling.** 200 + `success:false` = deterministic rejection (bad PDF) —
never retried; it is logged in `scorecard_ingest_log` + GroupMe. 5xx = transport
error — retried 3×, then reported to `/events/lp_report_ingest_failed`.
The IF sends **only** `success:false` to telemetry — the previous wiring had the
branches reversed and filed a bogus `transport_error` after every SUCCESS
(observed 2026-08-05: 22:05:54 success → 22:05:55 "transport_error").
